nuggets.text: The Golden Flashes were once the Silver Foxes, because the school president raised silver foxes on his farm.
Before Flash the golden eagle, the Golden Flashes' mascots included Grog, a caveman from the comic strip B.C.
Nick Saban played defensive back for the Golden Flashes under coach Don James from 1970 to 1972.
Hall of Famer Jack Lambert arrived at Kent State as a quarterback, moved to defensive end, then became a middle linebacker.
Julian Edelman was a three-year starting quarterback for the Golden Flashes before catching passes for the Patriots.
The Golden Flashes won their first-ever bowl game in 2019, beating Utah State 51-41 in the Frisco Bowl.
When the Golden Flashes' Dix Stadium opened in 1969, construction delays meant teams dressed elsewhere and were bused in.
Golden Flashes coach Mark Carney first joined Kent State in 2023 as its tight ends coach.
The Golden Flashes went from zero wins in 2024 to five wins in 2025.
Saturday marks the first meeting ever between the Golden Flashes and the Wofford Terriers.
